headline: Nigeria Seeks Senate Approval for $21.5 Billion External Borrowing Plan
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu asked the Senate to approve an external borrowing plan totaling $20.52 billion and €1.05 billion to fund infrastructure.
why: Large-scale sovereign borrowing by Africa's largest economy impacts its external debt profile, sovereign credit ratings, and international debt servicing costs.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Increasing external debt obligations expands infrastructure funding but raises long-term debt sustainability concerns.
